names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 decembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Calinic», with the rank words left off.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Θύρσος, Λεύκιος και Καλλίνικος», with the rank word left off. The page glosses the name itself, «(κάλλος + νίκη) = ο ωραίος και ένδοξος νικητής». The alternative «Κορωνάτος» the page reports is recorded in the attestation and not stored as a second form.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 14. децембар ст. ст., „Свети мученици Тирс, Левкије и Калиник.“ — with «Свети мученици» left off and the last of the three bare forenames taken; the Caesarea of the display name is in the body, and «жрец идолски» is the station the body gives him and not part of a name. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders.

The calendar’s own name page for him is «Каллиник Кесарийский (Вифинский), мч.»; the rank is stripped and both forms of the place kept, the parentheses being the page’s own. The day line declines the bare forename, «Каллиника». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

feast.note: The same menologion day this folder’s other rows already carry, so there is no second day and none is noted. **THE OTHER TWO MEN OF THIS LINE WERE WITHHELD AND NOT UPGRADED, AND THE REASON IS NOT ABOUT THEM BUT ABOUT A RULING.** `thyrsus-of-caesarea` and `leucius-of-caesarea` already hold venerated russian rows on 14 августа ст. ст. — the calendar’s «Мчч. Фирса, Левкия, Короната и дружины их (249-251)» — and a saint who already holds such a row on another day is governed by an author question BRIEF-RUSSIAN §4 and BRIEF.md §4 answer differently, so nothing was written for either. This folder’s own russian row was `undocumented`, its 17 августа companion being Coronatus and not him, so there is no such question here. THE READINGS THIS ENTRY LINKS WERE NOT OPENED: this folder’s life is already written out of its other sources. The day page’s one kontakion is written here — see the hymn’s own note.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 декабря ст. ст. — «Мчч. Фирса , Левкия и Каллиника (249-251).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 14 decembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Calinic»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Θύρσος, Λεύκιος και Καλλίνικος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already keeps, and the entry is the same company: the three of Bithynian stock living at Caesarea under the eparch Koumbrikios. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. **The two companions' own `greek` rows are already `venerated` and they sit on 17 Αυγούστου**, taken from saint.gr's «Άγιοι Θύρσος, Λεύκιος, Κορωνάτος και η συνοδεία τους»; this folder's `greek` row was `undocumented`, so only it is written here, and the second Greek day of Thyrsus and Leucius is left exactly where it is. **The page also gives this man a second name: «Οι Άγιοι Θύρσος, Λεύκιος και Καλλίνικος (κατ' άλλους Κορωνάτος)» — called Coronatus by others — and this corpus keeps a separate folder, `coronatus-of-caesarea`, for a Coronatus of the same company. Whether those are one man is an identity question for the author; nothing here is merged and no folder is removed.** The page names Bithynia and Caesarea and no coordinate is proposed. It prints the six-named apolytikion of the day and a kontakion in Ἦχος δ’ that names no one but calls the day's martyrs the luminaries of the Church — a common printed under this company's name, which is taken as theirs.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 27.12.2025 (14. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Тирс, Левкије и Калиник.“

attestations.note: The third name of the day’s enumerated three; the heading is quoted whole on each of the three folders; URL year 2025, and this is the day the Romanian and Greek rows on this folder already carry. `types` UNTOUCHED: «мученици» is the `martyr` held, and «жрец идолски», AN IDOL-PRIEST, is the station he was converted out of and no rank of the Church — nothing was added for it. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the folder’s `floruit` of 225–275 is saint.gr’s «στα μέσα του 3ου αιώνα», and this book names the emperor Koumvrikios, Decius’s successor, without a year, which that interval already covers. NO `locations`. NO `related` ROW ADDED: Thyrsus, Leucius and `cornutus-of-iconium` are already here. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, and it is the whole of what he was: THE IDOL-PRIEST OF THE THREE. Where Thyrsus and Leucius were honourable citizens of Caesarea, he served the idols — and he was converted to the faith of Christ by seeing many idols fall at the power of Thyrsus’s prayer under torture. He was condemned with Thyrsus and beheaded with the sword, where the saw sent against Thyrsus could not scratch the wood of his chest. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Tirs, Levchie, Calinic, Filimon, Apolonie și Arian (a common of martyrs, printed once for the six together; «nesctricăciunii» is the page's own reading)

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received from you, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having your strength they overthrew the tormentors, and broke also the feeble insolence of the demons. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Tὴν ἑξαστέλεχον μαρτύρων φάλαγγα, ᾀσμάτων ἄνθεσιν ἀνευφημήσωμεν, ὡς καθαιρέτας τοῦ ἐχθροῦ καὶ στύλους τῆς εὐσεβείας· Θύρσον καὶ Φιλήμονα καὶ στερρὸν Ἀπολλώνιον, Ἀρριανόν Καλλίνικον καὶ τὸν ἔνδοξον Λεύκιον· αὐτοὶ γὰρ οὐρανίων χαρίτων κόσμῳ πυρσεύουσι τὴν αἴγλην.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ', Τὴν ὡραιότητα. The same apolytikion is printed on both of the day's company pages, «Άγιοι Θύρσος, Λεύκιος και Καλλίνικος» and «Άγιοι Φιλήμων, Απολλώνιος, Αρριανός και οι τέσσερις Προτεκτοράτοι», and it names six men across the two entries — Thyrsus, Philemon, Apollonius, Arrianus, Callinicus and Leucius — so it is the service of both companies together and is taken into the folder of each man it names whose Greek row this batch writes.

english.text: Let us acclaim with the flowers of our songs the six-stemmed phalanx of the martyrs, as destroyers of the enemy and pillars of piety: Thyrsus and Philemon and the steadfast Apollonius, Arrianus, Callinicus and the glorious Leucius; for they kindle for the world the radiance of the graces of heaven.

hymns.text: Τοὺς φωστῆρας ἅπαντες, τῆς Ἐκκλησίας, συνελθόντες σήμερον, ἐν ἐγκωμίοις ἱεροῖς, ἀνευφημοῦντες ὑμνήσωμεν, ὡς ἀθλοφόρους Χριστοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of «Άγιοι Θύρσος, Λεύκιος και Καλλίνικος». It names nobody, which makes it a common printed under this company's name and so this company's own service; it names no other saint, so the mis-hang rule does not touch it.

english.text: Coming together today, let us all acclaim and hymn the luminaries of the Church with sacred praises, as prize-winners of Christ our God.

hymns.text: Благочестия веры поборницы,/ злочестиваго мучителя оплевавше,/ обличисте зверообразное его кровопролитие/ и победисте того яростное противление,/ Христовою помощию укрепляеми, Фирсе и Левкие,// с пострадавшими о нас молитеся.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 декабря ст. ст. — «Кондак мучеников», глас 2. THE TEXT NAMES TWO OTHER MEN AND NOT HIM, and it is written here on purpose. It addresses «Фирсе и Левкие, с пострадавшими» — Thyrsus and Leucius, with those who suffered with them — and the day line that carries it names him third of exactly that company, as his own `related` rows to both men already do. It is the company’s kontakion and not another saint’s proper, which is the test `BRIEF.md` §4 sets. It is NOT written on the folders of the two men it names, because both already hold a venerated russian row on 17 августа ст. ст. and were withheld under the ruling named in this row’s note.

english.text: O champions of the faith of piety, who spat upon the impious torturer, ye laid bare his beast-like shedding of blood and overcame his furious resistance, being strengthened by the help of Christ. O Thyrsus and Leucius, with those who suffered alongside you, pray for us.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Οι Άγιοι Θύρσος, Λεύκιος και Καλλίνικος (κατ' άλλους Κορωνάτος) έζησαν στα μέσα του 3ου αιώνα μ.Χ.» The bounds are the middle of that century as the page states it; it gives no year of birth and no year of death.
